name: CAP flight cap insignia, officers and general officers
size_basis: Vanguard product page "Civil Air Patrol Flight Cap Device: Senior Members and Officers" prints 1 1/4 x 1 1/4 in; the art is the officer service device (same figure), so its height is set to 1.25 in and its width follows the figure aspect (1.18 in)
provenance: CAPR 39-1 3 Mar 2020 Fig A5-8 (p.138, CAP DEVICES row and the devices as drawn on the caps; A5-9 shows the same devices on the women's caps) and p.139 (flight caps, same device); same geometric build as cap-device-officer-service

mounts.uniform: USAF-style flight cap (Class A / Class B / FDU), officers incl. general officers
mounts.rule: front left flap, centred halfway between the top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.1); Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device (ICL 25-02), cadet NCOs/airmen the cap-device-nco-flight, cadet officers regular or miniature metal grade (6.2.2.2.2-3)

documented: officers wear the flight cap insignia on the front left flap (6.2.2.2.1)
assumed: feather and leaf shapes are stylised
